title: Tomb Raider Game of the Year Edition
provenance: Reported by diego-wendt (highball-db#63, 2026-09-16), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 15.7.9, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 11 minutes on the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer. LoginPro (highball-db#149, 2026-09-20): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M4, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.28, Wine's own Direct3D (wined3d), 6 minutes played through Highball; the minor issues were not described.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT after a session of 11 minutes, so the report covers launch and the opening rather than a long run. The reporter played the Epic copy; the Steam id here is the same game on Steam. A second reporter played 6 minutes on Wine's own Direct3D on an M4 with macOS 27 and rated it playable with minor issues, so the game runs on two modes and DXMT is the one rated higher. No measurement here yet.
